nodes.label: Migration: Create collaboration and governance tables
nodes.description: Creates discussion_threads, discussion_messages, approvals, audit_logs, and notifications tables for team collaboration, approvals workflow, and audit trailing

nodes.label: Table: discussion_threads
nodes.description: Stores threaded conversations with project context, privacy level (private vs client-visible), and status tracking

nodes.label: Table: discussion_messages
nodes.description: Stores individual messages within discussion threads with author, content, and attachments

nodes.label: Table: approvals
nodes.description: Multi-level approval workflow tracking requester, approver, subject type/ID, and status (Pending, Approved, Rejected, Clarification)

nodes.label: Table: audit_logs
nodes.description: Immutable activity trail recording user actions (create, update, delete, login, export) with subject, metadata, IP, and user-agent for compliance

nodes.label: Table: notifications
nodes.description: In-app notification feed per user with title, message, channel (in-app, email, sms), read status, and action URL

nodes.label: Migration: Update users table with RBAC fields
nodes.description: Adds role, status (Active/Suspended/Inactive), and avatar_url columns to users table for RBAC and user profile management

nodes.label: Migration: Create permission tables (Spatie)
nodes.description: Creates Spatie permission package tables: permissions, roles, model_has_permissions, model_has_roles, role_has_permissions for granular RBAC

nodes.label: Table: permissions
nodes.description: Granular permission definitions with name and guard_name (api, web), unique constraint per guard

nodes.label: Table: roles
nodes.description: Role definitions (super_admin, partner, manager, etc.) with optional team scoping and unique constraint per team/guard

nodes.label: Table: model_has_permissions
nodes.description: Polymorphic junction mapping individual models to permissions (direct permission assignment)

nodes.label: Table: model_has_roles
nodes.description: Polymorphic junction mapping individual models to roles (users to roles, entities to roles)

nodes.label: Table: role_has_permissions
nodes.description: Bridge table linking roles to permissions with cascade delete for permission/role management

nodes.label: Migration: Create project tracker tables
nodes.description: Creates tracker_circles (team groups), tracker_circle_members (membership), and tracker_rows (case entries) with seeded Circle A and B

nodes.label: Table: tracker_circles
nodes.description: Operational team groups (Circle A: Patent & IP Portfolio, Circle B: FER & Project Tracker) with description and slug

nodes.label: Table: tracker_circle_members
nodes.description: Membership mapping users to tracker circles with unique constraint preventing duplicate memberships

nodes.label: Table: tracker_rows
nodes.description: Individual matter entries with docket, client, PCM/SCM/PR assignments, delivery due date, payment and completion tracking

nodes.label: Migration: Link tracker rows to projects and rename stages
nodes.description: Adds project_id FK to tracker_rows; renames Opposition→Object received and Registered→Granted in project_stages

nodes.label: Migration: Add GST and client detail fields
nodes.description: Adds client classification fields: client_type, GST (has_gstin, gstin, gst_type), nationality, legal_name, PAN, CIN, bank details, referred_by_code

nodes.label: Migration: Make tracker row status nullable
nodes.description: Changes tracker_rows status and payment_status columns from default values to nullable to allow undefined states

nodes.label: Migration: Create IP notifications table
nodes.description: Creates ip_notifications table with type (deadline, task, payment, system), metadata (docket, client, days_remaining, role), and read tracking

nodes.label: Table: ip_notifications
nodes.description: Specialized notifications for IP deadlines and tasks with JSON metadata and read_at timestamp for notification tracking

nodes.label: Migration: Add salary and discussion tag columns
nodes.description: Adds employees.salary (decimal 12,2) and discussion_threads.tag (default 'General') for payroll and discussion organization

nodes.label: Migration: Create payroll tables
nodes.description: Creates payroll_runs (monthly batch with period, status, totals) and payslips (per-employee snapshots with gross, deductions, net_pay)

nodes.label: Table: payroll_runs
nodes.description: Monthly payroll batch with unique period (first day of month), status (Draft/Finalized/Paid), employee_count, and totals (gross, deductions, net)

nodes.label: Table: payslips
nodes.description: Individual payslip snapshots per employee per payroll run with gross, LOP, basic, HRA, special allowance, deductions (PF, ESI, PT, TDS), and net_pay

nodes.label: Migration: Encrypt PII columns (backfill)
nodes.description: Widens PII columns to TEXT and encrypts plaintext values (idempotent); handles employees [aadhaar, PAN, UAN, ESI, bank account/IFSC] and clients [bank account/IFSC]

nodes.label: Migration: Create module tables (compliance, HR, recruitment)
nodes.description: Creates compliance_items, reminders, feedback_entries, performance_reviews, performance_goals, performance_feedback360, job_postings, job_candidates, offboarding_cases, integrations, and portal_enabled flag on clients

nodes.label: Table: compliance_items
nodes.description: IP deadline tracking by jurisdiction with type (Patent/Trademark/Copyright), deadline, action_required, status (Critical/At Risk/On Track/Compliant/Resolved)

nodes.label: Table: reminders
nodes.description: User-scoped reminders with category (Deadline/Meeting/Follow-up/Renewal), due_date, time, scope (self/team), completion flag, and source reference

nodes.label: Table: feedback_entries
nodes.description: Client satisfaction survey entries with rating, category, comment, and entry_date

nodes.label: Table: performance_reviews
nodes.description: Employee performance reviews per period with rating, status (Not Started/In Progress/Completed), and scores/comments in JSON

nodes.label: Table: performance_goals
nodes.description: Performance goals tracked per employee with title, due_label, progress (0-100), and status (On Track/etc.)

nodes.label: Table: performance_feedback360
nodes.description: 360-degree feedback routing from peer to employee with sent_label and status (Pending/Submitted)

nodes.label: Table: job_postings
nodes.description: Job posting management with title, department, posted_date, applicant_count, status (Active/Closed), description, and employment_type

nodes.label: Table: job_candidates
nodes.description: Recruitment pipeline tracking candidate stage (Applied/Screening/Interview/Offer/Hired) with applied_label

nodes.label: Table: offboarding_cases
nodes.description: Exit management with employee, department, last_day, exit_type (Resignation/Retirement/Termination), status, 8-item checklist, assigned HR, completed_label

nodes.label: Table: integrations
nodes.description: Third-party tool integration registry with slug (unique), name, category, initials, color, connected flag, last_sync, sync_freq, and config JSON

nodes.label: Migration: Encrypt employee salary field (EncryptedSafe)
nodes.description: Idempotent encryption of employees.salary using Crypt::encryptString; detects already-encrypted values by 'eyJ' prefix (EncryptedSafe marker)

nodes.label: Migration: Convert tracker row user strings to user IDs
nodes.description: Backfills pcm_id, scm_id, pr_id FK columns from existing pcm, scm, pr name strings via case-insensitive user lookup; drops string columns

nodes.label: Migration: Add user preferences and system settings
nodes.description: Adds timezone (default 'Asia/Kolkata'), language, notification_prefs JSON to users; creates system_settings key-value store with company_name, currency, fiscal_month, max_upload_mb

nodes.label: Table: system_settings
nodes.description: Global configuration key-value store with unique keys: company_name (MYPL), currency (INR), fiscal_month (April), max_upload_mb (50)

nodes.label: Migration: Add FK columns to module tables
nodes.description: Adds FK columns: compliance_items.assignee_id → users; performance_reviews [employee_id, reviewer_id] → [employees, users]; performance_goals.employee_id → employees; offboarding_cases [employee_id, assigned_hr_id] → [employees, users]; job_candidates.job_posting_id → job_postings

nodes.label: Migration: Add IP matter fields to projects
nodes.description: Adds IP-specific fields: docket_number, application_number, patent_office_code, service_code, case_type, filing_date, secondary_manager_id FK, patent_engineer_id FK, notes

nodes.label: Migration: Truncate performance, recruitment, offboarding sample data
nodes.description: Clears all sample data from performance_feedback360, performance_goals, performance_reviews, job_candidates, job_postings, offboarding_cases

nodes.label: Migration: Truncate feedback and reminders sample data
nodes.description: Clears all sample data from feedback_entries and reminders

nodes.label: Migration: Truncate compliance sample data
nodes.description: Clears all sample data from compliance_items

nodes.label: Migration: Idempotent add missing client columns
nodes.description: Conditionally adds missing client columns (client_type, legal_name, entity_subtype, PAN, CIN, GST fields, bank details) with guards to prevent duplicate additions

nodes.label: Migration: Change salary column to TEXT for EncryptedSafe
nodes.description: PostgreSQL ALTER COLUMN TYPE for employees.salary: decimal(12,2) → TEXT (ciphertext requires more space than plaintext)

nodes.label: Migration: Create public holidays table
nodes.description: Creates public_holidays table with date, name, country (default 'IN'); unique constraint (date, country) for multi-country holiday calendars

nodes.label: Table: public_holidays
nodes.description: National holiday calendar for attendance and payroll calculations with country support

nodes.label: Migration: Add performance indexes (CONCURRENTLY)
nodes.description: Creates 68 non-blocking indexes using CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY; avoids write-locks in production; covers clients, projects, tasks, financial, HRMS, audit, tracker, module tables

nodes.label: Method: createConcurrently
nodes.description: Helper method to create indexes with CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY IF NOT EXISTS syntax; skips missing tables; called via unprepared raw SQL to avoid transaction wrapping

nodes.label: Seeder: CreateSuperAdminSeeder
nodes.description: Creates super_admin user (mugilvannan@myipstrategy.com, password: admin123) with firstOrCreate idempotent pattern; echoes credentials to console
